d:
The school crush that felt like the biggest love story ever.
We've all been there.
That one senior who walked through the corridor and suddenly... school became a lot more interesting.
Episode 1 of our brand-new school rom-com is here!
She's got the biggest crush on *the* senior everyone knows. He's charming, completely out of her league (or so she thinks), and has absolutely no idea she exists... yet.
